verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.viam.com that describes the platform, and Viam publishes a dedicated agent-oriented guide, "use Viam from an agent". That guide covers how an agent with a shell or SDK operates machines: listing resources and status, planning motion, and per-method permissions. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.
